strategy.name: intraday_sma_or_flat_start_reentry_grid
strategy.description: 在本地已批准 QQQ 日线的完整覆盖区间 1999-03-10 至 2026-08-04 复测同一策略。初始持有现金；数据起点后的 SMA 预热期不产生信号，等待第一个普通买入信号后全仓持有 QQQ。持仓时由成本止损、短均线慢性转弱、SMA25/30/35 当日变化率同时快速转弱或 SMA200 下穿中的任一规则全仓卖出；空仓时由卖出价上方强制买回、SMA200 上穿或短均线恢复中的任一规则全仓买回。扫描 R=0% 至 10%。
strategy.buy_rule: 初始空仓且没有上次卖价，因此仅允许完成相应 SMA 预热后的动态 SMA200 上穿或短均线恢复产生第一笔买入；以后空仓时再额外允许价格达到上次实际卖出价的 1+R。
strategy.sell_rule: 持仓时 OR：成本价 -1.5%；短均线平均变化率此前连续 6 日为负且当日仍为负并跌破动态 SMA130；此前连续 2 日短均线平均变化率为负且当日动态 SMA25、SMA30、SMA35 各自变化率全部不高于 -0.20%；动态 SMA200 下穿。
strategy.signal_time: 每个交易日开始前，仅用截至前一交易日 Close 的历史计算该日条件单及动态阈值公式；盘中是否触发由该日常规时段调整后 OHLC 判定。指标尚未完成预热时不生成对应条件单。
strategy.execution_time: 若前 Close 到当日 Open 已越过阈值，按当日 Open；否则常规时段 OHLC 触及阈值时按精确理论阈值；零滑点、零费用；每天最多一笔成交。
strategy.position_sizing: long-only，初始 100,000 美元现金；触发后全仓持有或全现金，允许小数股，不融资，现金不计息。
strategy.initial_position: 1999-03-10 起空仓等待；第一笔正常买入成交前不计入策略与 Buy & Hold 的正式比较区间。

single_rule_ablation.scope: For every R=0% through 10%, compare all rules against disabling each of the seven buy/sell signals one at a time.
single_rule_ablation.metric_start: Use the all-rules common first-entry date for every ablation; later entry caused by removing a buy rule remains cash and is included in performance.

financing: disabled; flat cash earns zero interest
benchmark: At the strategy's first actual buy fill, invest the same 100,000 USD in QQQ at that identical fill price; compare both paths only from that date through 2026-08-04 Close.

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v3 unchanged because this is the same strategy and report interaction contract with only the analysis interval expanded to all approved QQQ history.

research.hypothesis: The complete available QQQ history can reveal whether the R response and any drawdown improvement persist across multiple market regimes.
research.primary_metric: Report all R=0% through 10% results for total return, CAGR, Sharpe, maximum drawdown, exposure and trade count against the common-entry QQQ benchmark; additionally report the same metrics after removing each rule one at a time for every R.
research.selection_rule: No parameter or rule removal is selected or promoted. R=5% is predeclared only as the trade-marker display case; sample extrema and ablation improvements are descriptive and the full response must be assessed for stability.
research.validation_plan: Every base and single-rule-ablation case must match PyBroker and the independent ledger. Base R cases must share the same first ordinary buy fill; every ablation is scored from that common date, remains flat when a removed buy rule delays entry, respects incomplete indicator warmup, and uses the exact approved QQQ data endpoints.
research.promotion_criteria: None. A full-history in-sample scan may inform later walk-forward design but cannot promote a parameter by itself.
research.rejection_conditions: Reject if the run invents pre-1999 warmup, trades before a valid ordinary buy, changes any non-date strategy parameter outside the declared single-rule ablation, changes the common metric start to favor a removed rule, uses a different benchmark entry, trades more than once per day, or diverges from the independent ledger.
